text:
elaine_cs: heads up — HyperPulse (pilot starting Mon) is seeing 5xxs from EU customers during load tests. They're asking for a temporary regional QPS bump and an IP allowlist so their edge peering can route through FRA. renewal at risk if pilot doesn't go smoothly :worried:

kai_sre: can you confirm exact numbers? target qps and duration? also need the customer IPs and whether they can accept a soft-fail (throttled) vs hard reject.

elaine_cs: requested 400 qps sustained for 14 days, then auto-revoke. IPs: 203.0.113.45, 203.0.113.46. They want FRA region preferred, fallback to AMS. Pilot SLA expectation is 99.9ms p95, but they're okay with slight latency bump.

kai_sre: ok. FRA capacity looks tight this week — we can do 400 qps in FRA if we reserve dedicated burst pool, otherwise route to AMS with FRA preferred. Security needs to sign off on those IPs. I'll sketch the config and ticket it.

lina_eng: FYI routing to FRA requires peering request to infra; lead time ~36-48h for route propagation if we request now. If you need instant, we should do AMS fallback.

elaine_cs: customer really prefers FRA because their SREs are in Frankfurt. Do the peering request now and in parallel do an AMS temporary route so tests can pass today. I'll tell HyperPulse.

ben_csm: renewal note: customer execs will watch first 72h. Let's do 14-day bump with auto-revoke, and capture performance logs + short CSAT followup at day 7. If any regressions, we'll offer a short credit.

kai_sre: creating change request. Proposed config snippet to apply to routing policy (will add to ticket):

```
route_policy:
  customer: hyperpulse
  prefer_regions: [fra, ams]
  temp_qps:
    amount: 400
    window_days: 14
    auto_revoke: true
  allowlisted_ips: ["203.0.113.45", "203.0.113.46"]
  fallback: ams
```

kai_sre: also need approval from sec for IP allowlist and from billing for temporary reserved burst. @ops-bot can you open INC ticket and ping sec/billing?

ops-bot: created INC-43812 — "HyperPulse EU temporary qps bump + IP allowlist". Assigned: eng-oncall, infra, security, billing. ETA for FRA peering request submission: 2026-03-23 09:15 UTC. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-43812 :white_check_mark:

lina_eng: submitted peering request. Infra confirmed propagation estimate 40h. I'll monitor.

ben_csm: copying suggested CSAT message for day 7: "Hi — quick check-in from Redwood: how did the pilot experience in EU look? Any latency or error patterns we should address?" keeps it simple.

elaine_cs: perfect. @kai_sre once sec/billing confirm can you apply AMS fallback now so they can resume tests?

kai_sre: sec approved IPs (sec-approved@redwood). billing approved a 2-week reserved burst at the agreed rate. Applying AMS fallback now and queuing FRA peering when available. Patch applied at 3072109901. Monitoring dashboards up.

ops-bot: change INC-43812 updated: AMS fallback active, FRA peering pending. Patch ID: patch-2026-03-21-77.

elaine_cs: thanks team — I'll update HyperPulse and add renewal risk notes to the account. keeping close watch for first 72h. :thumbsup:

ben_csm: noted for renewal — will include performance + CSAT in the renewal packet.

kai_sre: monitoring shows 2xx rate back to normal in AMS. will post update if FRA comes online.

ops-bot: INC-43812 status: monitoring. last action: AMS fallback applied (3072109901).
